lines.t: (Verse 1)
Before the dawn breaks through the line,
A distant light begins to shine.
The earth bends, the heavens shake,
For all creation waits for Him.
The watchmen cry from Zion’s height,
“Awake, awake—behold His light!”
The earth responds with trembling sound,
The Kings footsteps shaking the ground.
(chorus)
Let the trumpet shake the sky,
Lift our hearts, draw us nigh.
Every word, strong and pure,
Calls Your people to endure.
Trumpets blaze before the King,
All of heaven starts to sing.
When the mighty blast is heard—
The mountains lean in stillness now,
The valleys wait in solemn vow.
The nations look with trembling gaze,
For justice burns in royal flame.
The humble rise, restored and new,
Their hope secured in all You do.
Your radiance pours across the land,
The truth descends at Your command.
(Chorus)
Let the trumpets shake the sky,
Lift our hearts, draw us nigh.
Every word, strong and pure,
Calls Your people to endure.
Trumpets blaze before the King,
All of heaven starts to sing.
When the mighty blast is heard—
We rise in faith upon Your word.
Mercy… truth…
YahuShua…
Let the trumpets ring divine,
With Your love in glorious shine.
Holy… Holy…
YahuShua…
As the final blast is poured,
Every knee bows to the Lord.
(Final chorus)
YahuShua,
Let the shofar shake the sky,
Lift our hearts, draw us nigh.
Every echo, deep and pure,
Calls Your people to endure.
(Outro)
YahuShua,
Crowns thrown at Your feet,
Bride made ready and prepared to meet
And when the last great call is done—
We rise in glory with the Son.
